## Overview

Two decode-time launch-elimination fastpaths for the DSpark draft sampling chain on gfx950 (MI355X): a fused markov-bias GEMV (embed + GEMV + add in one Triton kernel) and a fused sample epilogue, engaged at draft batches at or below `VLLM_DRAFT_SAMPLING_FUSION_MAX_TOKENS` (default 2 — the measured crossover; above it the stock GEMM's tiled weight reuse wins).

Part of the DSV4.1-Flash MI355X serving fastpath series — four **independent** single-commit PRs (originally cut on `main`@90c4a1a73e), each reviewable and mergeable separately, in any order. Siblings: #63179 (tiny-M quant fusion + lm_head guard), #63180 (fused shared experts), #63182 (draft-prepare fastpaths). The four series PRs all register kill switches in `vllm/envs.py` at the same anchor and therefore conflict textually with each other there; the resolution is to keep both sides. Rebased onto current `main` (`717cf84342`): the `apply_output_logit_transform` hook that landed inside the region this PR touches in `dspark/speculator.py` is kept alongside the fused-epilogue call (both sides), and the rebased tip was re-verified with a fresh quick A/B pair (see the current-base benchmark under Validation).

## Claims

- **Fused markov bias GEMV** (`dspark_markov_fused_gemv.py`): the stock per-draft-step chain runs an embed gather, a bf16 GEMV against `markov_w2` [129280, 256], and an add — three launches whose latencies add serially at b ≤ 2. One Triton kernel does all three (fixed-order fp32 accumulation, no atomics). The sampler is untouched (identical RNG stream); only the GEMM accumulation order can differ (≤ 2 bf16 ULP from the stock chain, both within 1 ULP of an fp64-grounded reference). Kill switch `VLLM_DISABLE_MARKOV_FUSED_GEMV`.
- **Fused sample epilogue** (`sample_epilogue_fused.py`): the stock `_sample_logits` epilogue runs a `sample_pos` offset, an `idx_map` copy, `gumbel_sample`, `argmax`, a gather and a `draft_tokens` copy per draft position. One Triton kernel replicates that chain bit-exactly (same block width and noise helpers as the stock kernel) and writes the `draft_logits` cache rows and `draft_tokens` cells in-kernel; a persistent scratch buffer keeps the output address stable for CUDA-graph replay and the arrival counters self-clean. Armed only on the exact chain it replicates: probabilistic full-vocab drafting, no d2t scatter, no draft watermarker. Kill switch `VLLM_DISABLE_DRAFT_SAMPLE_EPILOGUE_FUSION`.
- **−550 µs median decode ITL (−9.0%) on the current base** (`main`@`717cf84342`) — official DSV4.1-Flash serving command at TP=4 on MI355X, complete separation among the sampled runs (current-base benchmark under Validation). The submission-base study measured **−3.51% (−255/−297 µs)** over 12 position-balanced A/B cycles with complete distribution separation; the absolute win deepened as `main` got faster (−609 µs on `be03d19750`, −550 µs on the current tip — the same launch elimination cuts deeper on a faster base). TTFT unchanged within noise (draft-path only).

## Validation

**Benchmark (current base, `main`@`717cf84342`)** — official serving command (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, DSpark k=5, `--monokernel`, MI355X), measured at TP=4; the gates key on draft batch rows, not TP size. Both arms run this branch's tip; the OFF arm disables only this PR's two levers. One fresh A/B pair: fresh server per arm, 2 sampled + 1 greedy client run per arm (16 prompts, ISL 16 / OSL 2048, concurrency 1); arm statistic = median of per-run mean ITL; lever engagement census-asserted from the server log on both arms.

| metric | ON (fused) | OFF (stock) | delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| decode ITL (median of per-run mean) | 5.552 ms | 6.102 ms | **−550 µs (−9.0%)** |

Every paired run faster (per-run means ON 5.528/5.552/5.969 vs OFF 6.109/5.622/6.102 ms, 2 sampled + 1 greedy), with complete separation among the sampled runs (ON max 5.552 ms below OFF min 5.622 ms); TTFT stays within run-to-run scatter (per-run median TTFT: ON 16.3–17.6 ms, OFF 17.6–17.8 ms — the levers touch only the decode draft path). Isolated ~30 ms server stalls inflate two of the six per-run means (OFF run-1 and the ON greedy run) while their per-run medians sit at body level — the same transient noted on the sibling PRs of this series. Matches the prior-base re-check (−609 µs on `be03d19750`); the win is larger in absolute terms than the submission-base study below because the new base itself is faster, so the same launch elimination cuts deeper.

**Submission-base 12-cycle study** (original measurement, same command and arms) — 12 position-balanced A/B cycles (blocked AAA BBB, then BAB, then ABA), fresh server per arm per cycle, 2 sampled + 1 greedy client run per cycle; arm statistic = median of per-run mean ITL; lever engagement asserted from the server log before the client runs:

| metric | ON median | OFF median | delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| ITL t>0 | 7.020 ms | 7.276 ms | −255 µs (−3.51%) |
| ITL t0 | 6.913 ms | 7.209 ms | −297 µs |
| TTFT t>0 | 24.89 ms | 24.72 ms | +0.16 ms |
| TTFT t0 | 24.71 ms | 24.98 ms | −0.27 ms |

Complete distribution separation (ON max 7.066 ms below OFF min 7.208 ms).

**Accuracy** — gsm8k, 5-shot, strict match, 1319 samples, one run per arm: ON 0.9272, OFF 0.9272. Both inside the 0.9196–0.9340 band observed across repeated draws of this build. The only numerics-affecting lever is the fused GEMV's ≤ 2 bf16 ULP accumulation difference, which reshuffles borderline answers run to run; across the series the paired on/off deltas scatter on both sides of zero and no arm falls outside the band.

**Tests** — all new tests pass locally on MI355X (gfx950):

```
pytest tests/kernels/test_dspark_markov_fused_gemv.py \
       tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dspark_sample_epilogue_fusion.py -q
26 passed
```

CI notes: both test files run on GPU CI pools (validated locally above on gfx950). The full pre-commit suite passes on the changed files (ruff, typos, mypy, check-torch-cuda-call, check-forbidden-imports, check-test-tethering, ...), and the commit is DCO-signed.

The posted tip adds lint/type fixes over the benchmarked tree: the markov kernel module imports triton via `vllm.triton_utils` (pre-commit `check-forbidden-imports`; the same triton underneath), the speculator's fused-GEMV guard condition is inlined into the loop (behavior-identical restructure for mypy narrowing), and the tests use `torch.accelerator.synchronize()` instead of `torch.cuda.synchronize()`. No measured-path semantics change.

<details><summary>Reproduction</summary>

Server (ON arm) — official serving command, as measured at TP=4 (the fastpaths are not TP=4-specific):

```
VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1 AITER_TRITON_LOG_LEVEL=ERROR \
VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_SPARSE_MLA=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4 VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 \
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 --port 8123 \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --moe-backend aiter \
  --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' \
  --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}' \
  --block-size 128 --monokernel \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block","enable_adaptive_verification":false}'
```

OFF arm: identical, plus `VLLM_DISABLE_MARKOV_FUSED_GEMV=1 VLLM_DISABLE_DRAFT_SAMPLE_EPILOGUE_FUSION=1`.

Load (after a 4-prompt warmup; add `--temperature 0` for the greedy run):

```
vllm bench serve --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 \
  --port 8123 --backend openai --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 16 --random-output-len 2048 \
  --num-prompts 16 --max-concurrency 1 --ignore-eos \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --metric-percentiles 90,95,99 \
  --save-result
```

Accuracy (same engine config; `max_model_len 16384` and no `cpu_offload` are the only harness deviations):

```
python -c '
import lm_eval
lm_eval.simple_evaluate(
    model="vllm",
    model_args=dict(
        pretrained="deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017",
        max_model_len=16384, tensor_parallel_size=4,
        tokenizer_mode="deepseek_v41", gpu_memory_utilization=0.9,
        block_size=128, moe_backend="aiter", monokernel=True,
        attention_config={"indexer_kv_dtype": "mxfp4",
                          "indexer_sparse_logits": True},
        compilation_config={"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 6, 8]},
        speculative_config={"method": "dspark",
                            "num_speculative_tokens": 5,
                            "draft_sample_method": "probabilistic",
                            "rejection_sample_method": "block",
                            "enable_adaptive_verification": False}),
    tasks=["gsm8k"], num_fewshot=5, batch_size=8)'
```

</details>

## Details

Both gates are read per call and baked at CUDA-graph capture, so an eager in-process A/B works and each captured graph size keeps a fixed engagement. The levers win by launch elimination at tiny draft batches, and the fused GEMV re-reads `w2` per row, so wide batches keep the stock chain. The draft-MoE topk fastpath developed alongside these was measured neutral at the serving shape and is not carried here.

+"""Fused DSpark draft sampling epilogue.
+
+The stock per-draft-position sampling tail (``DSparkSpeculator.
+_sample_logits`` probabilistic path, full-vocab drafts such as
+DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: ``draft_id_to_target_id is None``) runs, for every
+one of the ``num_speculative_steps`` (=5) positions per decode step:
+
+    sample_pos[:, i] - 1          # tensor subtract  -> 1 kernel
+    idx_map[:, i].contiguous()    # strided-view copy (inside gumbel_sample)
+    gumbel_sample(...)            # the 127-block noise+argmax kernel
+                                  #   + full-row logits-cache store
+    local_max.argmax(dim=-1)      # phase-2 reduce   -> 1 kernel
+    local_argmax.gather(...)      # winner gather    -> 1 kernel
+    draft_tokens[:, i] = sampled  # slice copy       -> 1 kernel
+
+~5 kernel launches per position (~25 per decode step). This module fuses
+the whole tail into ONE Triton kernel per draft position:
+
+  * grid ``(num_tokens, num_blocks)`` with ``BLOCK_SIZE=1024`` — the
+    SAME block decomposition as the stock ``_gumbel_sample_kernel``, so
+    every per-block ``tl.max(..., return_indices=True)`` is the identical
+    operation on the identical values (the within-block tie behavior is
+    inherited bit-for-bit);
+  * the per-position ``sample_pos - 1`` subtract and the
+    ``idx_map``/``sample_pos`` strided-view contiguity copies disappear
+    (the kernel indexes both with their row strides);
+  * the noise/temperature/cache-store arithmetic is the stock code path
+    verbatim — the kernel calls the SAME ``@triton.jit`` helpers from
+    ``vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.gumbel`` (``spec_step_seed``,
+    ``murmur3_uniform32/64``, ``_log1p_neg_stable``, the draft noise
+    salt), applies the temperature division on the fp32-converted logits
+    in the same order, and stores the RAW pre-temperature values into
+    the logits cache at the same addresses;
+  * phase 2 (``local_max.argmax`` + gather + the ``draft_tokens`` slice
+    copy) folds into the same launch: each program writes its
+    (value, token_id) partial, then bumps a per-row arrival counter with
+    an acq_rel atomic; the LAST program to arrive for a row performs the
+    final reduction — first-block-wins over the block maxima, exactly
+    ``torch.argmax(dim=-1)`` + ``gather`` semantics — and writes both the
+    sampled id buffer (the returned ``prev`` for the next Markov step)
+    and ``draft_tokens[row, step]`` directly.
+

+``draft_tokens`` are bit-identical to the stock chain (same ops, same
+order, same tie-breaks; the atomic only selects WHICH program runs the
+fixed deterministic reduction, never the result). The arrival counter is
+self-cleaning (the last program resets it to 0), so the kernel is
+CUDA-graph capture/replay safe (fixed scratch addresses, state returns
+to zero after every call). Fixed-seed maxdiff==0 is pinned by

+"DSpark draft sample-epilogue fusion READY/engaged/is DISABLED/gated
+off".
+
+Draft-batch gate: like the fused markov GEMV it pairs with, the fusion
+wins by launch elimination at tiny draft batches and loses to the stock
+sampler at large ones (measured crossover on MI355X between 2 and 4
+concurrent requests; the ship shape is 1). It engages at num draft rows

+    USE_FP64: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,

detail.body:
## Overview

Two decode-time launch-elimination fastpaths for the DSpark draft sampling chain on gfx950 (MI355X): a fused markov-bias GEMV (embed + GEMV + add in one Triton kernel) and a fused sample epilogue, engaged at draft batches at or below `VLLM_DRAFT_SAMPLING_FUSION_MAX_TOKENS` (default 2 — the measured crossover; above it the stock GEMM's tiled weight reuse wins).

Part of the DSV4.1-Flash MI355X serving fastpath series — four **independent** single-commit PRs (originally cut on `main`@90c4a1a73e), each reviewable and mergeable separately, in any order. Siblings: #63179 (tiny-M quant fusion + lm_head guard), #63180 (fused shared experts), #63182 (draft-prepare fastpaths). The four series PRs all register kill switches in `vllm/envs.py` at the same anchor and therefore conflict textually with each other there; the resolution is to keep both sides. Rebased onto current `main` (`717cf84342`): the `apply_output_logit_transform` hook that landed inside the region this PR touches in `dspark/speculator.py` is kept alongside the fused-epilogue call (both sides), and the rebased tip was re-verified with a fresh quick A/B pair (see the current-base benchmark under Validation).

## Claims

- **Fused markov bias GEMV** (`dspark_markov_fused_gemv.py`): the stock per-draft-step chain runs an embed gather, a bf16 GEMV against `markov_w2` [129280, 256], and an add — three launches whose latencies add serially at b ≤ 2. One Triton kernel does all three (fixed-order fp32 accumulation, no atomics). The sampler is untouched (identical RNG stream); only the GEMM accumulation order can differ (≤ 2 bf16 ULP from the stock chain, both within 1 ULP of an fp64-grounded reference). Kill switch `VLLM_DISABLE_MARKOV_FUSED_GEMV`.
- **Fused sample epilogue** (`sample_epilogue_fused.py`): the stock `_sample_logits` epilogue runs a `sample_pos` offset, an `idx_map` copy, `gumbel_sample`, `argmax`, a gather and a `draft_tokens` copy per draft position. One Triton kernel replicates that chain bit-exactly (same block width and noise helpers as the stock kernel) and writes the `draft_logits` cache rows and `draft_tokens` cells in-kernel; a persistent scratch buffer keeps the output address stable for CUDA-graph replay and the arrival counters self-clean. Armed only on the exact chain it replicates: probabilistic full-vocab drafting, no d2t scatter, no draft watermarker. Kill switch `VLLM_DISABLE_DRAFT_SAMPLE_EPILOGUE_FUSION`.
- **−550 µs median decode ITL (−9.0%) on the current base** (`main`@`717cf84342`) — official DSV4.1-Flash serving command at TP=4 on MI355X, complete separation among the sampled runs (current-base benchmark under Validation). The submission-base study measured **−3.51% (−255/−297 µs)** over 12 position-balanced A/B cycles with complete distribution separation; the absolute win deepened as `main` got faster (−609 µs on `be03d19750`, −550 µs on the current tip — the same launch elimination cuts deeper on a faster base). TTFT unchanged within noise (draft-path only).

## Validation

**Benchmark (current base, `main`@`717cf84342`)** — official serving command (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, DSpark k=5, `--monokernel`, MI355X), measured at TP=4; the gates key on draft batch rows, not TP size. Both arms run this branch's tip; the OFF arm disables only this PR's two levers. One fresh A/B pair: fresh server per arm, 2 sampled + 1 greedy client run per arm (16 prompts, ISL 16 / OSL 2048, concurrency 1); arm statistic = median of per-run mean ITL; lever engagement census-asserted from the server log on both arms.

| metric | ON (fused) | OFF (stock) | delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| decode ITL (median of per-run mean) | 5.552 ms | 6.102 ms | **−550 µs (−9.0%)** |

Every paired run faster (per-run means ON 5.528/5.552/5.969 vs OFF 6.109/5.622/6.102 ms, 2 sampled + 1 greedy), with complete separation among the sampled runs (ON max 5.552 ms below OFF min 5.622 ms); TTFT stays within run-to-run scatter (per-run median TTFT: ON 16.3–17.6 ms, OFF 17.6–17.8 ms — the levers touch only the decode draft path). Isolated ~30 ms server stalls inflate two of the six per-run means (OFF run-1 and the ON greedy run) while their per-run medians sit at body level — the same transient noted on the sibling PRs of this series. Matches the prior-base re-check (−609 µs on `be03d19750`); the win is larger in absolute terms than the submission-base study below because the new base itself is faster, so the same launch elimination cuts deeper.

**Submission-base 12-cycle study** (original measurement, same command and arms) — 12 position-balanced A/B cycles (blocked AAA BBB, then BAB, then ABA), fresh server per arm per cycle, 2 sampled + 1 greedy client run per cycle; arm statistic = median of per-run mean ITL; lever engagement asserted from the server log before the client runs:

| metric | ON median | OFF median | delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| ITL t>0 | 7.020 ms | 7.276 ms | −255 µs (−3.51%) |
| ITL t0 | 6.913 ms | 7.209 ms | −297 µs |
| TTFT t>0 | 24.89 ms | 24.72 ms | +0.16 ms |
| TTFT t0 | 24.71 ms | 24.98 ms | −0.27 ms |

Complete distribution separation (ON max 7.066 ms below OFF min 7.208 ms).

**Accuracy** — gsm8k, 5-shot, strict match, 1319 samples, one run per arm: ON 0.9272, OFF 0.9272. Both inside the 0.9196–0.9340 band observed across repeated draws of this build. The only numerics-affecting lever is the fused GEMV's ≤ 2 bf16 ULP accumulation difference, which reshuffles borderline answers run to run; across the series the paired on/off deltas scatter on both sides of zero and no arm falls outside the band.

**Tests** — all new tests pass locally on MI355X (gfx950):

```
pytest tests/kernels/test_dspark_markov_fused_gemv.py \
       tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dspark_sample_epilogue_fusion.py -q
26 passed
```

CI notes: both test files run on GPU CI pools (validated locally above on gfx950). The full pre-commit suite passes on the changed files (ruff, typos, mypy, check-torch-cuda-call, check-forbidden-imports, check-test-tethering, ...), and the commit is DCO-signed.

The posted tip adds lint/type fixes over the benchmarked tree: the markov kernel module imports triton via `vllm.triton_utils` (pre-commit `check-forbidden-imports`; the same triton underneath), the speculator's fused-GEMV guard condition is inlined into the loop (behavior-identical restructure for mypy narrowing), and the tests use `torch.accelerator.synchronize()` instead of `torch.cuda.synchronize()`. No measured-path semantics change.

<details><summary>Reproduction</summary>

Server (ON arm) — official serving command, as measured at TP=4 (the fastpaths are not TP=4-specific):

```
VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=3600 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1 AITER_TRITON_LOG_LEVEL=ERROR \
VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_SPARSE_MLA=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4 VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 \
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 --port 8123 \
  --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --moe-backend aiter \
  --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' \
  --attention-config '{"indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}' \
  --block-size 128 --monokernel \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block","enable_adaptive_verification":false}'
```

OFF arm: identical, plus `VLLM_DISABLE_MARKOV_FUSED_GEMV=1 VLLM_DISABLE_DRAFT_SAMPLE_EPILOGUE_FUSION=1`.

Load (after a 4-prompt warmup; add `--temperature 0` for the greedy run):

```
vllm bench serve --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 \
  --port 8123 --backend openai --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 16 --random-output-len 2048 \
  --num-prompts 16 --max-concurrency 1 --ignore-eos \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --metric-percentiles 90,95,99 \
  --save-result
```

Accuracy (same engine config; `max_model_len 16384` and no `cpu_offload` are the only harness deviations):

```
python -c '
import lm_eval
lm_eval.simple_evaluate(
    model="vllm",
    model_args=dict(
        pretrained="deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017",
        max_model_len=16384, tensor_parallel_size=4,
        tokenizer_mode="deepseek_v41", gpu_memory_utilization=0.9,
        block_size=128, moe_backend="aiter", monokernel=True,
        attention_config={"indexer_kv_dtype": "mxfp4",
                          "indexer_sparse_logits": True},
        compilation_config={"cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 6, 8]},
        speculative_config={"method": "dspark",
                            "num_speculative_tokens": 5,
                            "draft_sample_method": "probabilistic",
                            "rejection_sample_method": "block",
                            "enable_adaptive_verification": False}),
    tasks=["gsm8k"], num_fewshot=5, batch_size=8)'
```

</details>

## Details

Both gates are read per call and baked at CUDA-graph capture, so an eager in-process A/B works and each captured graph size keeps a fixed engagement. The levers win by launch elimination at tiny draft batches, and the fused GEMV re-reads `w2` per row, so wide batches keep the stock chain. The draft-MoE topk fastpath developed alongside these was measured neutral at the serving shape and is not carried here.

@@ -0,0 +1,227 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Tests for the fused Markov bias in DSpark sequential draft sampling.
+
+``fused_markov_bias_add`` (vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/
+dspark_markov_fused_gemv.py) replaces the stock per-step chain (embed
+gather + bf16 GEMV + add) with ONE Triton kernel. The sampler is
+untouched (identical RNG stream); only the GEMM fp32 accumulation
+order can differ, so the result is NOT bit-exact with rocBLAS. These
+tests bound the deviation (<= 2 bf16 ULP vs the stock chain, both
+within 1 ULP of an fp64-grounded reference), prove determinism, cover
+the strided base-logits slice and int32/int64 token ids the speculator
+passes, check the eligibility fallbacks (kill switch, draft-batch
+gate, dtype/shape/contiguity misses), and prove CUDA-graph capture +
+replay stability (the chain is captured inside the DSpark FULL draft
+graph).
+"""
+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from tests.kernels.utils import bf16_ulp_distance
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.dspark_markov_fused_gemv import (
+    fused_markov_bias_add,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="the fused kernel runs on GPU"
+)
+
+_KILL_VAR = "VLLM_DISABLE_MARKOV_FUSED_GEMV"
+_GATE_VAR = "VLLM_DRAFT_SAMPLING_FUSION_MAX_TOKENS"
+
+# The serving shape (DSV4.1-Flash): markov_w2 is [129280, 256] bf16
+# replicated on every rank; B = num_reqs, n_spec = 5.
+_SERVING_V, SERVING_R = 129280, 256
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _clean_env():
+    os.environ.pop(_KILL_VAR, None)
+    # The numerics/eligibility tests exercise the kernel itself: lift the
+    # draft-batch gate so every B engages. The gate policy (the measured
+    # crossover between the fused chain and the stock GEMM) has its own
+    # dedicated test below.
+    os.environ[_GATE_VAR] = "1024"
+    yield
+    os.environ.pop(_KILL_VAR, None)
+    os.environ.pop(_GATE_VAR, None)
+
+
+def _stock_chain(prev, w1, w2, base_slice):
+    """Exactly the speculator's stock ops (gather + bf16 GEMM + add)."""
+    markov_embed = torch.nn.functional.embedding(prev, w1)
+    bias = markov_embed @ w2.t()
+    return base_slice + bias
+
+
+def _make_case(V, R, B, n_spec, dtype, seed, id_dtype):
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    device = "cuda"
+    w1 = (torch.randn(V, R, device=device) * 0.02).to(dtype)
+    w2 = (torch.randn(V, R, device=device) * 0.02).to(dtype)
+    base = (torch.randn(B, n_spec, V, device=device) * 0.5).to(dtype)
+    prev = torch.randint(0, V, (B,), dtype=id_dtype, device=device)
+    return w1, w2, base, prev
+
+
+def _compare_fused_to_stock(prev, w1, w2, base_slice, tag):
+    stock = _stock_chain(prev, w1, w2, base_slice)
+    fused = fused_markov_bias_add(prev, w1, w2, base_slice)
+    assert fused is not None, f"{tag}: unexpectedly fell back"
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert fused.shape == stock.shape and fused.dtype == stock.dtype
+    max_ulp = int(bf16_ulp_distance(fused, stock).max().item())
+    assert max_ulp <= 2, f"{tag}: fused deviates from stock by {max_ulp} ULP"
+    # Selection stability: identical argmax except where the top-2 logits
+    # are within 8 ULP (a rounding-level tie).
+    top2 = stock.topk(2, dim=-1)
+    gap_ulp = bf16_ulp_distance(top2.values[..., 0:1], top2.values[..., 1:2]).squeeze(
+        -1
+    )
+    mism = (fused.argmax(-1) != stock.argmax(-1)) & ~(gap_ulp <= 8)
+    assert not mism.any(), (
+        f"{tag}: {int(mism.sum())} rows flipped argmax beyond the 8-ULP tie band"
+    )
+    return fused, stock
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("B", [1, 3])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("id_dtype", [torch.int32, torch.int64])
+def test_matches_stock_chain_serving_shape(B, id_dtype):
+    """Serving shape (V=129280, R=256, n_spec=5), base logits as the
+    strided [B, n_spec, V][:, 2] view the speculator passes."""
+    w1, w2, base, prev = _make_case(
+        _SERVING_V, SERVING_R, B, 5, torch.bfloat16, 11, id_dtype
+    )
+    _compare_fused_to_stock(prev, w1, w2, base[:, 2], "serving")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("V,R", [(257, 130), (64, 8)])
+def test_matches_stock_chain_masked_shapes(V, R):
+    """Non-power-of-2 / sub-block V and R exercise the load masks."""
+    w1, w2, base, prev = _make_case(V, R, 4, 5, torch.bfloat16, 12, torch.int64)
+    _compare_fused_to_stock(prev, w1, w2, base[:, 0], f"V={V},R={R}")
+
+
+def test_fp64_reference_bound():
+    """Both paths implement "round the dot to bf16, add to the base in fp32,
+    round once" -- the stock chain's semantics, which the fused kernel
+    copies verbatim. Against the EXACT fp64 dot, both must agree with
+    round_bf16(base + round_bf16(dot_fp64)) within 1 bf16 ULP. (A plain
+    single-rounded fp64 reference is the WRONG bound: the intermediate bias
+    rounding shifts near-cancellation outputs by many ULPs in BOTH paths --
+    that is the stock numerics the fused kernel must preserve.)"""
+    w1, w2, base, prev = _make_case(4096, 256, 4, 5, torch.bfloat16, 13, torch.int64)
+    base_slice = base[:, 3]
+    dot_ref = torch.nn.functional.embedding(prev, w1).double() @ w2.t().double()
+    expected = (base_slice.float() + dot_ref.to(torch.bfloat16).float()).to(
+        torch.bfloat16
+    )
+    stock = _stock_chain(prev, w1, w2, base_slice)
+    fused = fused_markov_bias_add(prev, w1, w2, base_slice)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    for name, got in (("stock", stock), ("fused", fused)):
+        max_ulp = int(bf16_ulp_distance(got, expected).max().item())
+        assert max_ulp <= 1, (
+            f"{name} deviates from the fp64-grounded chain semantics by {max_ulp} ULP"
+        )
+
+
+def test_deterministic():
+    """Fixed-order fp32 accumulation, no atomics: repeated runs bitwise
+    identical."""
+    w1, w2, base, prev = _make_case(
+        _SERVING_V, SERVING_R, 2, 5, torch.bfloat16, 14, torch.int64
+    )
+    a = fused_markov_bias_add(prev, w1, w2, base[:, 1])
+    b = fused_markov_bias_add(prev, w1, w2, base[:, 1])
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert torch.equal(a, b)
+
+
+def test_env_kill_switch_falls_back():
+    os.environ[_KILL_VAR] = "1"
+    w1, w2, base, prev = _make_case(512, 64, 2, 5, torch.bfloat16, 15, torch.int64)
+    assert fused_markov_bias_add(prev, w1, w2, base[:, 0]) is None
+
+
+def test_draft_batch_gate_falls_back():
+    """The fusion engages at num draft rows <=
+    VLLM_DRAFT_SAMPLING_FUSION_MAX_TOKENS (default 2 -- the measured
+    crossover between launch-elimination wins and the stock GEMM's tiled
+    weight reuse); larger batches keep the stock chain, a raised gate
+    re-engages."""
+    os.environ.pop(_GATE_VAR)  # restore the default (2)
+    w1, w2, base, prev = _make_case(512, 64, 3, 5, torch.bfloat16, 16, torch.int64)
+    # Batch 3 > default gate 2: stock chain.
+    assert fused_markov_bias_add(prev, w1, w2, base[:, 0]) is None
+    # Batch 2 <= gate: fused.
+    out = fused_markov_bias_add(prev[:2], w1, w2, base[:2, 0])
+    assert out is not None and out.shape == (2, 512)
+    # Raised gate: batch 3 fuses again.
+    os.environ[_GATE_VAR] = "8"
+    out = fused_markov_bias_add(prev, w1, w2, base[:, 0])
+    assert out is not None and out.shape == (3, 512)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "mutate",
+    [
+        "fp32_weights",
+        "noncontig_w2",
+        "vocab_mismatch",
+    ],
+)
+def test_ineligible_shapes_fall_back(mutate):
+    w1, w2, base, prev = _make_case(512, 64, 2, 5, torch.bfloat16, 16, torch.int64)
+    base_slice = base[:, 0]
+    if mutate == "fp32_weights":
+        w1 = w1.float()
+        w2 = w2.float()
+    elif mutate == "noncontig_w2":
+        # [V, R] view with column-major layout: stride(-1) != 1.
+        w2 = w2.t().contiguous().t()
+    elif mutate == "vocab_mismatch":
+        base_slice = base_slice[:, :500]
+    assert fused_markov_bias_add(prev, w1, w2, base_slice) is None, (
+        f"{mutate} should fall back to the stock chain"
+    )
+
+
+def test_graph_capture_replay():
+    """The chain is captured inside the DSpark FULL draft CUDA graph: the

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Fused Markov bias for DSpark sequential draft sampling.
+
+The stock sequential stage runs, per draft step (k=5 steps per decode step,
+num_reqs rows each):
+
+    markov_embed = markov_w1[prev]        # nn.Embedding gather   [B, R]
+    bias         = markov_w2 @ markov_embed  # replicated bf16 GEMV [B, V]
+    logits_i     = base_logits[:, i] + bias  # elementwise add      [B, V]
+
+-- three kernels and a 66 MB weight read (markov_w2 is [129280, 256] bf16,
+replicated on every rank) per step. This module fuses all three ops into ONE
+Triton kernel per step:
+
+    out[b, v] = bf16( bf16( sum_r w2[v, r] * w1[prev[b], r] ) + base[b, v] )
+
+with the dot accumulated in fp32 at a fixed sequential order (deterministic;
+no atomics). The rounding sequence mirrors the stock chain: the GEMV result
+is rounded to bf16 exactly like the bf16 GEMM output, then added to the base
+logits in fp32 and rounded once (torch bf16 elementwise-add semantics). The
+only allowed deviation is the fp32 accumulation ORDER inside the dot, so the
+result is NOT guaranteed bit-exact with rocBLAS. The gumbel sampler is
+untouched -- the RNG stream is identical.
+
+The draft step is fully captured by the DSpark FULL CUDA graph, and a Triton
+kernel launch is capturable like any other, so the fused kernel replays
+in-graph (the choice is baked at capture).
+
+Kill switch: VLLM_DISABLE_MARKOV_FUSED_GEMV=1 (read per call, so eager
+in-process A/B works). Ineligible shapes (non-bf16/fp16, non-contiguous
+weights, TP-sharded w2, mismatched vocab, confidence-head mode) fall back to
+the stock chain.
+
+Draft-batch gate: the fusion wins by launch elimination at tiny draft
+batches and loses to rocBLAS at large ones -- the kernel's grid is
+(v-blocks, batch), so every batch row re-reads the full w2 weight and
+its memory traffic scales O(batch * weight bytes), while the stock GEMM
+tiles over batch and re-reads w2 O(batch / tile) times. The measured
+crossover on MI355X is between 2 and 4 concurrent requests (the ship
+shape is 1), so the fusion engages at num draft rows <=
+VLLM_DRAFT_SAMPLING_FUSION_MAX_TOKENS (default 2, shared with the
+sample-epilogue fusion) and falls back to the stock chain above. Read
+per call; under CUDA graphs the choice is baked per captured size.
+"""
+
+import os
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
